items.before: Nothing changes on screen. Screen reader users now hear the commodity total cards ('Animals summary' and 'Packages summary'), 'Your commodities', the task list and each numbered section as named regions they can jump between. Plants' overview gets the same regions for its task groups, with no visible heading added.
items.after:
Nothing changes on screen.

Screen reader users now hear these parts of the overview as named regions they can jump between:

- the commodity total cards ('Animals summary' and 'Packages summary')
- 'Your commodities'
- the task list
- each numbered section

Plants' overview gets the same regions for its task groups.

Plants does not add a visible heading for them.

items.before: Hub regions for assistive technology and the 'Main import reason' row
items.after: Named regions on the overview (the hub) for assistive technology, and the 'Main import reason' row

items.before: Before, the Transit countries task appeared as soon as arrival details were saved, even with no commodity chosen. Now it shows only when the consignment needs transit countries, such as travelling by rail or road, and reads To do until at least one country is added.
items.after:
Before, the Transit countries task appeared as soon as arrival details were saved.

It appeared even when no commodity had been chosen.

Now it shows only when the consignment needs transit countries, such as travelling by rail or road.

It reads To do until at least one country is added.

items.before: A saved arrival date that is now more than 7 days in the past turns the Arrival details task back to To do, so the trader updates it before submitting.
items.after:
If a saved arrival date is now more than 7 days in the past, the Arrival details task goes back to To do.

This is so the trader updates it before submitting.
